notes: Both articles governing a noun with a genitive pronoun (τῆς μητρός, τοὺς θησαυρούς) are unrepresented under rule 20's displacement, the possessive belonging to αὐτοῦ and αὐτῶν.
down in they fell down completes the English verb and answers to no separate token; πίπτω carries no preverb, so rule 106 is not in question.
